_comment: Managed mode, aggregated serving of the smallest current Qwen model (Qwen3-0.6B) on an AMD-only cluster: a fast, cheap end-to-end smoke test that the llm-d path (Gateway + GAIE + modelservice, all three helm releases) works at all, before pointing it at a real-sized model. decode.image is set explicitly to a public vLLM image because dummy_llm_d's own built image is a CPU-only benchmark client with no vLLM installed -- the role image default (the --tags-selected model's own image) would not be able to serve. See 06-managed-qwen3-0.6b-nvidia.json for the same test on an NVIDIA cluster: only gpu_vendor and decode.image differ.
_comment_charts: infra/modelservice.ref override the defaults' oci://ghcr.io/... refs: as of writing, anonymous 'helm pull'/'helm template' against those two ghcr.io packages returns 401/403 (the gaie/inferencepool chart on registry.k8s.io is unaffected and needs no override). Both charts are also published to a plain, genuinely anonymous GitHub Pages Helm repo, so point there instead: run once before installing, 'helm repo add llm-d-infra https://llm-d-incubation.github.io/llm-d-infra/ && helm repo add llm-d-modelservice https://llm-d-incubation.github.io/llm-d-modelservice/ && helm repo update'. Versions below are each chart's latest as of writing; re-check with 'helm search repo <alias> --versions'.
